description: Train a FastGS panoramic 3DGS model. Wraps ``train.py`` with the full knob set from ``scripts/config.sh``: staged densification, ``max_gaussians``, focused sampling, ``--dynamic`` + bbox, ``data_sources = original|fixed|both``.
docs:
Stage-1 or stage-2 FastGS training. Data-source selection determines
which subtree(s) of the input dataset are loaded:

* ``original`` — reads ``sparse/0/`` + ``<images_dir>/``.
* ``fixed``    — reads ``sparse_fixed/0/`` + ``images_fixed/``.
* ``both``     — loads both, keeps camera lists separate.

### Dataset shape

This branch's ``scene/dataset_readers.py`` reads COLMAP
``sparse/0/*.bin`` (with a ``.txt`` fallback) plus the images
directory named by ``params.images``. When ``data_sources=both``,
wire the input from ``fastgs-colmap-overlay`` so both original and
``_fixed`` subtrees sit under one root.

### Dynamic mode (--dynamic)

Enables the deformation head + per-frame time coordinate. Image
stems MUST match ``frame_XXXXX[_face]`` (regex in
``dynamic/deformation.frame_key``). ``bbox`` input, if wired,
overrides the ``<source>/person_bbox.ply`` auto-detection.
Training resume is disabled in dynamic mode (raises at boot).

### Staged densification

Lists are passed as space-free comma strings and split in the shell.
Same schema as ``scripts/config.sh`` DENSIFY_MILESTONES,
DENSIFICATION_INTERVAL, GRAD_ABS_THRESH.

* ``densify_milestones = "7000,10000"`` → two switch iterations.
* ``densification_interval = "500,250,100"`` → three stage intervals.
* ``grad_abs_thresh = "0.0002,0.0001,0.00005"`` → three thresholds.

Length ``M`` for milestones implies ``M+1`` for the two lists (one
per stage). Leave milestones empty for the single-stage default.

### Focused sampling

``focus_camera_index`` OR ``focus_image_stem`` (mutually exclusive).
Once set, ``focus_from_iter`` and ``focus_sample_probability`` bias
the training-batch sampler toward that target.

description: Static FastGS training with independent masked RGB loss and differentiable alpha silhouette supervision.
docs:
Uses the installed FastGS trainer without modifying its repository.
RGB loss only uses masks; an additional binary cross-entropy alpha loss (or optional L1 loss)
supervises foreground opacity and background transparency. No alpha
channel is inserted into ground-truth RGB. Dynamic mode is unsupported.
Outputs per-1000-step loss records and CUDA memory/time statistics.

name: person-gray-mask

masks.description: arrayed<mask>[frame], sorted by filename. The image co-tag declares the existing single-image file contract for every mask leaf. The aggregate is a directory; each element is one file named <image-stem>.png (storage: file), decoded as single-channel uint8 at the source image width and height. Values are 0 (background) or 255 (foreground / valid RGB loss). Validated before success: nonempty inputs, unique stems, exact PNG filename coverage, matching image dimensions, binary values, and foreground coverage strictly between 5% and 95%. Hidden .done is an execution marker, not an array element.

description: Gray-wall foreground extraction with adaptive Lab color seeds and GrabCut. Validates every image stem and size; white means valid RGB loss.
